notes.title: Not releasing any time soon!
notes.content:
Due to lack of funding the game will be on hold for a period of time!

I still have to work on so many of the levels and all of the graphics need to be edited and made better! With my new course at school and work I do not have enough time on my hands and do not have enough money to hire a graphics artist. So, the game is on hold for the moment!
